name: End-of-Discharge SOC Cutoff

verification_procedure: Hardware LVD protection verified at 44.0V pack cutoff

name: End-of-Charge SOC Cutoff
description: Battery upper cutoff state of charge (hardware High Voltage Disconnect: Pack 56.8V / Cell 3.55V = 100.0% SOC).
source_doc: Huawei ESM Telecom Specification & Physical Telemetry
verification_procedure: Hardware HVD protection verified at 56.8V pack cutoff
